prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one individually drawn full-body 2D fighting-game sprite. Reference image 1 is the accepted Ribbit Uzi-homage selection sprite: it is the exact character and costume to preserve. Reference image 2 is official Iconic Ribbit for identity; image 3 is official Uzi for outfit motifs only. Change the pose as requested while keeping the same slender biological green frog, huge raised white/black eyes, pale mint muzzle, pink cheeks, pink bow tie, black pom-pom beanie behind the eyes, black hoodie with white screen/crossbones emblem, violet double sleeve bands, dark fluffy hem, long uncovered green legs, violet ankle bands and broad rounded black ankle boots with dark gray soles. Bare green hands. Keep exactly the same 2D dark outlines, flat colors, restrained cel shading, proportions and costume details as image 1. No robot head, hair, visor, mechanical limbs, pants, weapons, tools or extra accessories.
POSE — quick attack: a clear straight green open-hand strike toward screen-right at shoulder height, the other arm tucked in guard, lead knee bent, rear leg braced. The torso and full reaching hand fit inside the frame; no weapon or energy effect. Wide canvas approximately 1536 by 1024.
Entire single character only, three-quarter facing screen-right, face directed right. Preserve both eyes and both feet, with all anatomy inside the canvas and ample transparent margin on every side. Genuine transparent background with native alpha. No scenery, floor, shadow, glow, smoke, floating particles, text, labels, grid, border or duplicate figure. Output one finished sprite, not a sheet or a comparison. Redraw the pose naturally; do not merely rotate or mirror the source.

observations: Attaque inspectée : bras avant tendu et paume verte projetée vers la droite, seconde main en garde, genou avant fléchi et jambe arrière d’appui. Deux yeux et deux bottines complets ; bonnet, nœud, motif du sweat et bandes violettes cohérents.
